bands.title: Commendation
bands.text: Charged, and the file will survive anything a defence barrister does to it.

bands.title: Charged
bands.text: The right man, and enough working to justify it.

bands.title: Referred
bands.text: The Crown will take it. Ms Ballard's name is cleared, which was the more urgent thing.

bands.title: Open verdict
bands.text: The original finding is quashed and nothing replaces it. Better than nothing, and not by much.

bands.title: The finding stands
bands.text: The file closes as it closed before, and Ines Ballard remains, on the public record, a woman who killed her manager and drowned herself.

replay.find: It cannot be established from this report
replay.note: Pathology cannot say when Ballard died. The order of the two deaths has to come from somewhere else.

replay.find: Feeder tie F-3 was closed at 06:02:14 on credential I.BALLARD
replay.note: The original finding rests on her card. A card is not a person.
Intake gate 2 was open only from 02:31 to 03:12 that night.
She was found inside the sealed gallery, downstream of gate 2.

replay.find: while gate 2 is open will be drawn to the racks
replay.note: A body only reaches panel 4 while gate 2 is open. So Ballard was in the water between 02:31 and 03:12, hours before Sarn died at 06:03.

replay.find: no control room door event of any kind
replay.note: Nobody came or went from the control room between 02:29 and 05:44, and Vey never left. The F-3 tie was closed from that room.
Mbeki was across the footbridge in the powerhouse from 21:04 to 06:05. Cleared.
Okonkwo was down wet well 2 on a monitored permit at the key times. Cleared.
The instrument array Vey certified was never connected: a fraud he needed to keep hidden.
One gap all night: console 1 alarms went unanswered from 02:38 to 03:05. Vey was away from his console for 26 minutes, inside the gate 2 window.

replay.find: recovered from the second drawer of the control room desk
replay.note: Her card was in the control room desk drawer, not on her body. Someone else used it at 06:02.
A debris mat formed over panel 4 at 04:12. She was already there, long before 06:02.
Vey revised the drawing to hide the live second feed, F-3. Sarn isolated F-5 and trusted the drawing.

replay.find: He was not in the room the card was in
replay.note: Wrenn was on a recorded call from the dam crest when F-3 was closed. Cleared.
The motive: $186,000 paid to his spouse's company after certifications he signed.

debrief: At which phase did you first doubt the sequence of the two deaths? That moment is the case.
Did the phase gates help you think, or did you want everything at once?
Did the Authority limit ever hurt? If nobody agonised over a choice, the budget is too generous.

badges.title: A card is not a person
badges.text: Proved whose hand was on the credential in The Ravensgate Interlock.
